chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Imran, from Ziyad al-Qandi, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'If there are two Thursdays in the beginning of the month, then fast the first of them, for it is superior; and if there are two Thursdays in the end of the month, then fast the last of them, for it is superior.'
ai.seo_question: Which Thursday should be fasted in Shaban if there are two?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides a specific jurisprudential ruling regarding the selection of voluntary fasting days in Shaban, emphasizing the virtue of Thursday fasts. He instructs that if a month contains two Thursdays, one should fast on the first Thursday if it occurs in the early part of the month, or the last Thursday if it occurs in the latter part, as these are considered the most virtuous days for fasting. This guidance highlights the Shia emphasis on aligning voluntary acts of worship with the lunar calendar to maximize spiritual reward.
